questions.text: Do you hold a current ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type II or PCI DSS certification covering the services you provide?
Is MFA enforced for all staff access to systems that hold our data?
Is privileged access restricted, logged and reviewed at least quarterly?
Will you process our personal data only under a signed data processing agreement?
Are all locations where our data is stored or processed disclosed to us?
Is our data encrypted at rest (AES-256 or equivalent)?
Will you notify us of incidents affecting our data within 24 hours?
Do you keep a sub-processor list and notify us before changes?
Will you grant us and our regulators audit and access rights?
Is your BCP/DR plan tested at least annually?
Is an independent penetration test done at least annually?
If you use AI on our data, is it excluded from model training unless we agree?

clarifications.G1: Your ISO 27001 certificate expired on 10 Oct 2026. Please confirm its status and attach evidence of recertification.
clarifications.I3: Our contract requires notification within 24 hours. Your comment says 72 hours. Please confirm you can meet 24 hours and attach the signed addendum.
